description: Archify.fr is the local, autonomous and sovereign information system for operational continuity, designed to maintain access to essential information when the primary information system is inaccessible. Deployed on site and prepared in advance, Archify.fr provides authorised personnel with a local digital environment in which they can access, update and share the information required for the organisation’s continuity. The platform can provide access to continuity procedures, response sheets, directories, emergency contacts, technical documentation, plans, forms and schedules. Depending on the type of organisation, it can also maintain local access to business continuity and disaster recovery plans (BCP/DRP – PCA/PRA in France), municipal safeguard plans (PCS) or business continuity and recovery plans for healthcare organisations (PCRA). Archify.fr also includes a local collaborative solution that enables authorised personnel to communicate, share information and coordinate their actions. The platform operates without relying on the Internet or a connection to the primary information system. It therefore provides a capability that can be activated immediately in the event of a cyberattack, IT failure, communications outage or any other situation that makes the primary information system inaccessible. Archify.fr is designed for companies and industrial sites, healthcare organisations, local authorities and public services, operators of vital importance and defence organisations. Specific use cases illustrate its deployment at the Port autonome de Strasbourg, the Hôpital Européen de Marseille and the City of Vandœuvre-lès-Nancy. Discover how to prepare a local continuity capability before the primary information system becomes inaccessible.
